o1: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in Ras protein signal transduction and multiple developmental processes, including excretory system development; nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; neuron migration; P12 fate specification; and vulval fate specification. Is located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; hyp12; neurons; ventral nerve cord; and vulval cell. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction. Orthologous to human CCDC82 (coiled-coil domain containing 82).
